items.author: Kurt Helin
items.body_excerpt:
Ben Simmons returning to the NBA, joining the Kings on a one-year minimum deal

In 18 games with the Clippers two seasons ago, Simmons looked like he could be a solid backup point guard. The Kings are betting on it, with him playing behind Darius Acuff.
